name: Expandi
summary: LinkedIn and email outreach automation for sales teams and agencies — smart limits, warm-up and multi-account management.
best_for: sales teams and agencies running LinkedIn (and email) outreach at scale who want smart sending limits, warm-up and multi-account management
skip_if: you send occasional connection requests (LinkedIn's native tools suffice), or you're uneasy about automation against LinkedIn's terms of service
honest_knock: There is no free tier and no cheap entry — Expandi starts at $99 a month per seat, and the friendlier $79 assumes annual commitment. It's also LinkedIn automation, which sits in a grey zone against LinkedIn's own terms: powerful for outreach, but a platform-risk you own.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-07) 7-day free trial, no free plan. Business is $99 per month month-to-month; paying a year up front takes 20% off, $79 a month equivalent. The same page also calls this two months free; on its own figures it is $948 a year against $1,188, a saving of $240, which is closer to two and a half months of the $99 fee than two. Pricing is per seat and Expandi states that the discount grows with the number of seats you buy, so a multi-seat agency quote is not simply the seat price multiplied. Higher tiers add role and permission management and centralised billing. Taxes vary by country and are added on top.
